text:
Dear Avery,

I am writing to update you on our launch position. While our launch was tentatively scheduled for October 8, 2026, release requires completed approval from our security review. Nia owns the security review, which now completes October 12 at the earliest. Because the review may require remediation, no new production date is authorized at this time.

Our team remains completely focused on delivering a successful, secure release. In the meantime, a staging demo can still happen on October 8 using synthetic data. 

Please let me know whether you choose to accept the staging demo for October 8 so we can coordinate the next steps.

Best regards,

Jordan  
Engagement Lead
